name: Infernity Spear Bearer
desc: Gains 800 ATK while you have no cards in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Infernity Spear Bearer" once per turn. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Infernity" monster with 0 ATK from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. You can banish this card and 1 other "Infernity" card from your GY; send 1 "Void" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY.
